description:
Saya adalah mahasiswa yang memiliki ketertarikan di bidang teknologi, khususnya pengembangan web, backend development, dan Artificial Intelligence. Saya ingin membangun solusi inovatif yang memanfaatkan teknologi dan data NASA untuk menjawab permasalahan nyata di masyarakat.

Saya mencari anggota tim yang memiliki semangat belajar, mampu bekerja sama, serta tertarik pada bidang AI/ML, data science, UI/UX, dan pengembangan aplikasi. Mari berkolaborasi, bertukar ide, dan menciptakan solusi
summary: AstroGuard is an AI-powered astronaut health monitoring software that transforms complex biometric and space environment telemetry from NASA datasets into simple, actionable early warnings and plain-language health guidance for space mission crews.
details: During long-duration space missions, astronauts face critical health hazards such as microgravity-induced bone and muscle loss, cosmic radiation exposure, fatigue, and psychological stress. Raw medical telemetry and spacecraft sensor data are often too complex to interpret rapidly in high-pressure environments. AstroGuard bridges this gap by integrating real-time crew biometric monitoring and NASA space health datasets with an AI Plain-Language Explainer. Instead of overwhelming users with raw numbers, AstroGuard visualizes risk zones through an intuitive Crew Health Dashboard and Biometric Risk Map, detects early health anomalies, and provides clear, step-by-step countermeasures in everyday language for both astronauts and Mission Control flight surgeons. Unique Value: Turns overwhelming raw medical and space telemetry into clear, human-friendly early warnings and immediate recovery actions. Disclaimer: The interactive UI/UX prototype for this project was designed and generated with the assistance of Google Stitch AI.
